# Airwallex — Airwallex for Startups

Australia/New Zealand program tiered by funding stage. Pre-seed gets the Explore tier free for 3 months; Seed gets the Grow tier free for 3 months plus AUD$100,000 of fee-free payment collection and AUD$100,000 of fee-free FX; Series A+ is sales-handled.

| **When it ends** | Standard Airwallex fees and pricing apply after the promotional tier access ends. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pre-seed | — | Free access to Airwallex Explore tier for 3 months | No partner needed |
| Seed | $100,000 | Fee-free FX for the first AUD$100,000 worth of conversions | No partner needed |
| Series A and beyond | — | Contact our team | No partner needed |


> **Stacking:** Offers are accessed from the Rewards tab once the Airwallex account is set up. There is no cost to join the program.

### Where it is available

The vendor states this explicitly: `AU`, `NZ`.

> this program is focused on startups with a business entity registered in Australia or New Zealand, with a valid Australian Business Number (ABN) or New Zealand Business Number (NZBN)

### Notes

funding_required is left unknown deliberately: the FAQ says Airwallex "currently prioritise startups that have raised external funding – typically angel, seed, or institutional rounds", which is a prioritisation, not a stated requirement. Series A and beyond has no published benefit — the page says "Contact our team". This record covers the Australia/New Zealand page only; Airwallex runs separate per-market pages (Hong Kong at /en-hk/airwallex-for-startups, and a global newsroom release dated 29 October 2025 that describes the refreshed program starting in Singapore and mentions $10,000 business acceleration grants in local currencies for select regions). Airwallex itself warns the offers differ by market: "The Airwallex for Startups program's availability and specific benefits vary by market and are contingent upon eligibility checks, successful onboarding (including KYC/KYB) and applicable limits. Not all program features are available in all jurisdictions." Do not reuse the AUD figures for other markets. An active Airwallex account is required to access the offers. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source. AUDIT CORRECTION: the A$100,000 figure is the volume of currency conversion on which fees are waived, NOT a credit or a cash value. Recorded as a usage allowance with no headline amount.
